review_method: Contact-sheet visual screening. Remove vest predictions on jackets, shirts, overalls or harnesses. Reject obvious missing objects, problematic collages and duplicates. Not a pixel-level exhaustive manual annotation certification.
limitations: Contact-sheet screening is not exhaustive manual ground truth.
Helmet boxes retain source SHWD extents, which can include the face.
Exact duplicates removed; near duplicates filtered by dHash. Scene-level separation is not guaranteed.
loader_validation: Passed: Ultralytics loaded 420 train, 90 validation and 90 test images; no corrupt files; disjoint splits.
